segments.sn45.7:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn45.7:2.2: Kissa nu kho etaṃ, bhante, adhivacanaṃ –
segments.sn45.7:3.1: Evaṃ vutte so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn45.7:3.3: Katamaṃ nu kho, bhante, amataṃ, katamo amatagāmimaggo”ti?
segments.sn45.7:3.6: Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo amatagāmimaggo, seyyathidaṃ –

lines: Sattame nibbānadhātuyā kho etaṃ bhikkhu adhivacananti asaṅkhatāya amatāya nibbānadhātuyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
Āsavānaṃ khayo tena vuccatīti apica tena rāgādivinayena āsavānaṃ khayotipi vuccati.
Āsavakkhayo nāma arahattaṃ, arahattassāpi etaṃ rāgavinayotiādi nāmamevāti dīpeti.
Etadavocāti “satthārā nibbānadhātūti vadantena amataṃ nibbānaṃ kathitaṃ, maggo panassa na kathito.
Taṃ kathāpessāmī”ti anusandhikusalatāya pucchanto etaṃ avoca.
Rāgavinayā dipadehi nibbānaṃ vāpi vucceyya arahattaṃ vāpi.
Yasmā so bhikkhu ubhayatthapi niviṭṭhabuddhi, tasmā bhagavā tassa ajjhāsayavasena “nibbānadhātuyā kho etan”tiādinā nibbānadhātuṃ vissajjetvā puna “āsavānaṃ khayo tena vuccatī”ti āha.
Yasmā ariyamaggo rāgādike samucchedavasena vineti, āsavañca sabbaso khepeti, tena ca vuttaṃ nibbānaṃ arahattañca, tasmā tadubhayaṃ “rāgavinayotiādi nāmamevā”ti vuttaṃ.
Anusandhikusalatāya pucchanto etaṃ avocāti iminā “pucchānusandhi idha labbhatī”ti dīpitaṃ, ajjhāsayānusandhipi ettha labbhatevāti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
